about: gnap-caep-risc's own AuthZEN cases for the embedded Remote PEP (#39).
src/tests/authzen.rs runs every case through Client::decide or Client::decide_grant:
offline in local mode against a stub realm serving these policies and this catalogue,
and live (scripts/live_iya_sts.py --authzen) through a central and a local PEP each,
requiring central == local == expect. Policies are given to iya-sts as ALFA; xacml is
what iya-sts stored for that ALFA (the live run refuses a table whose xacml differs),
and is what the offline stub serves.

main.about: the GNAP client's own application, decided by the realm root

policies.name: gnap-authzen-root
alfa: attribute act { category = actionCat id = "urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:action:action-id" type = string }
attribute rtype { category = resourceCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:authzen:resource-type" type = string }
attribute protocol { category = environmentCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:protocol" type = string }
attribute app { category = environmentCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:authzen:application" type = string }
attribute acr { category = subjectCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:subject:acr" type = string }
attribute amr { category = subjectCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:subject:amr" type = string }
attribute authTime { category = subjectCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:subject:auth-time" type = integer }
attribute country { category = subjectCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:subject:country" type = string }
attribute staff { category = subjectCat id = "employeeType" type = string }
attribute amount { category = resourceCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:order:amount" type = double }
attribute archived { category = resourceCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:order:archived" type = boolean }
attribute created { category = resourceCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:order:created" type = dateTime }
attribute tags { category = resourceCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:order:tags" type = string }
attribute region { category = resourceCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:order:owner-region" type = string }
attribute quantity { category = resourceCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:order:quantity" type = integer }
attribute tenant { category = resourceCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:env:tenant" type = string }
attribute reason { category = actionCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:action:reason" type = string }
attribute channel { category = environmentCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:env:channel" type = string }
attribute deviceTrusted { category = environmentCat id = "urn:gnap-demo:env:device-trusted" type = boolean }
rule noDelete { deny target clause act == "delete" }
rule readAtLoa2 { permit target clause act == "read" target clause acr == "urn:gnap-demo:loa:2" }
rule strictRead { permit target clause act == "strict-read" target clause acr[mustbepresent] == "urn:gnap-demo:loa:2" }
rule refundWithOtp { permit target clause act == "refund" target clause amr == "otp" }
rule recentSignIn { permit target clause act == "approve-recent" condition integerGreaterThanOrEqual(integerOneAndOnly(authTime), 1700000000) }
rule singleMethod { permit target clause act == "single-method" condition stringEqual(stringOneAndOnly(amr), "pwd") }
rule payTooMuch { deny target clause act == "pay" target clause amount > 1000.0 }
rule pay { permit target clause act == "pay" target clause amount <= 1000.0 }
rule updateArchived { deny target clause act == "update" target clause archived == true }
rule update { permit target clause act == "update" target clause archived == false }
rule exportThisYear { permit target clause act == "export" target clause created >= dateTime("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z") }
rule readTagged { permit target clause act == "tag-read" target clause tags == "public" }
rule shipInEu { permit target clause act == "ship" target clause region == "eu" }
rule bulkUpTo100 { permit target clause act == "bulk" target clause quantity <= 100 }
rule cancelOnRequest { permit target clause act == "cancel" target clause reason == "customer-request" }
rule checkoutOnTrustedWeb { permit target clause act == "checkout" target clause channel == "web" target clause deviceTrusted == true }
rule auditOwnTenant { permit target clause act == "audit" target clause tenant == "acme" target clause app == "gnap-caep-risc-demo" }
rule taxInNz { permit target clause act == "tax-view" target clause country == "NZ" }
on permit { obligation "urn:sts:xacml:authzen:obligation:notification" { "to" = "ops@gnap-demo.test" "body" = "an order was opened" } }
rule staffRead { permit target clause act == "read" target clause staff == "staff" }

fga-ref.about: an application that enforces fine-grained authorization; its own policy references another (iya-sts #2027)

policies.name: gnap-authzen-fga-helper
alfa: attribute act { category = actionCat id = "urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:action:action-id" type = string }
attribute rtype { category = resourceCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:authzen:resource-type" type = string }
rule readDocuments { permit target clause act == "read" target clause rtype == "doc" }
attribute act { category = actionCat id = "urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:action:action-id" type = string }
attribute protocol { category = environmentCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:protocol" type = string }
rule purge { deny target clause act == "purge" }

fga-stage.about: an application that enforces fine-grained authorization, whose policy reads urn:sts:xacml:fga:stage

alfa: attribute act { category = actionCat id = "urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:action:action-id" type = string }
attribute stage { category = environmentCat id = "urn:sts:xacml:fga:stage" type = string }
rule noPurgeAtAccess { deny target clause stage == "access" target clause act == "purge" }

localDefect.where: iya-pep-rust src/authzen.rs: an evaluation about an application on the catalogue's fgaApplications is mapped without the two facts iya-sts's authzen_map.ts adds through fgaAccess() (urn:sts:xacml:fga:application in resource, urn:sts:xacml:fga:stage = access in environment), so local mode never matches a rule on the stage. Central answers Deny, local Permit; the live run fails on it.
